name: EZ-Login
author: Abolfazl Edalati

sections.description:
EZ-Login is the first and only free Persian plugin for SMS and Google login, developed by the Wiraweb team.

Installation and Usage

  1. After installing the plugin, go to the Settings section.
  2. In the main settings page, you can add your custom CSS in the provided field.
  3. In the SMS Settings page:
    • Select your SMS service provider.
    • Click the “Save” button.
  4. To enable Google Login:
    • Enter your Client ID and Client Secret in the respective fields.
    • Click the “Save” button.
    • For more details on how to obtain these parameters, see:
      Register with Google Account

How to Use

Use the shortcode below on any page or Elementor widget to display the login form:

[ez-login]

By default, users will be redirected to the homepage after logging in.

If you want to redirect them to a different page, you can use:

[ez-login link=”https://example.com/my-account/”]

Replace https://example.com/my-account/ with your desired redirect URL.

External Services

This plugin uses the following external services to facilitate SMS and Google login:

1) Google OAuth
– Used for Google login.
– During the login process, an authorization code and user data (email, name) are securely exchanged between your site and Google.
– Data is transmitted only when the user attempts to log in with Google.
– For Google’s privacy policy and terms of service:
– Privacy Policy
– Terms of Service

2) MeliPayamak
– Used for sending SMS verification codes (OTP).
– The user’s phone number and the OTP code are sent to MeliPayamak’s servers in order to deliver the SMS.
– Data is transmitted each time an OTP is requested.
– For MeliPayamak’s privacy policy and terms of service:
– MeliPayamak Website

sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin for login on the shopping cart page as well?

Yes, you can use the redirect feature in the shortcode (explained above) by adding the cart page link as the redirect URL.

Does this plugin affect site performance?

No, the plugin size is currently less than 10KB and does not cause any performance issues.
